title: Built in layers
sub: In the weeds of data crafting, a technical series for analytics engineers: the tests are red, and four layers turn them green. Each layer has one job, each CTE one step, and the rule and the count are written once.
howto: Four layers keep their colours: staging blue-grey, intermediate violet, core gold, marts green. Code on dark glass is the project, and the small label beside it says where it runs. Red is a test that fails; green, one that passes. Teal is an AI agent's work; gold is a person's approval.
